mapper.select: SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id) AS message_count FROM qa_sessions s WHERE s.id = #{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id) AS message_count FROM qa_sessions s WHERE s.space_id = #{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_sessions (id, space_id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{title}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
